correctness.rationale: Check actual affine branch slopes and images: low cells 1..3 map onto (0,1], cell4 onto (0,lambda], high cells i>=5 onto (0,lambda^(i-2)]; so each row is geometric with low three rows identical. A skip-free unit-downcrossing PGF r=z(1-lambda)/(1-lambda*r) has the minimal square-root branch. Cell4 contributes h4=z(1-lambda^2)/(1-lambda^2*r), producing F=z(1-lambda^3)+lambda^3*r*h4. Lagrange inversion yields the printed coefficients, the z=1 root yields the escape mass, differentiation below 1/2 yields mean, and a uniform square-root singularity gives n^-3/2 and the Gaussian critical scaling. Independent rational Markov propagation of 36 coefficient cases at 1/5,1/2,3/5 agreed exactly. The T_lambda is induced time, not original physical-time returns.
